faq.question: What is Anime Destiny?
faq.answer: Anime Destiny is a Roblox anime tower defense game where you summon anime units, upgrade and evolve them, and clear story stages, bosses, and endless trials.

faq.question: Where can I play Anime Destiny?
faq.answer: You can play Anime Destiny on the official Roblox experience page. The game supports mobile, tablet, PC, and console.

faq.question: How do I get free rewards in Anime Destiny?
faq.answer: Redeem Anime Destiny codes from the Codes button in-game. Active codes give Gems, RR, Cubes, and Malice to boost your early progress.

faq.question: Is Auto Roll free in Anime Destiny?
faq.answer: Yes. Auto Roll is free in Anime Destiny, so you can run repeated summons automatically while building your squad.

faq.question: What are the best units in Anime Destiny?
faq.answer: Mythic and Secret units are the main long-term investment targets in Anime Destiny. Check the Anime Destiny Unit Tier List for ranked picks across story, bosses, and late game.

faq.question: Where are official Anime Destiny updates posted?
faq.answer: Official Anime Destiny updates are shared in the Discord server and Roblox group. Bookmark the official links to avoid fake mirrors and expired invite reposts.
